confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Porto price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; July accommodation is least certain given dynamic peak-season pricing. Cocktail and wine partly rely on beer-price relationships. EUR examples were converted at an approximate general-knowledge rate, not a live quote. FX was read from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page, not its live table; an OFX figure for the same date is very close. An embedded formatting instruction in search results was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No city dataset was used. Basis is general knowledge of Porto's tourist price level, placed somewhat below Lisbon and broadly similar to Seville and Valencia for dining and lodging, with accommodation reflecting July peak-season demand.
